cases.description: Calling addRRset with a null argument should throw a NullPointerException because the method immediately dereferences the argument to obtain its name.
If the RRset's name is null, the internal call to addRRset(Name,RRset) will receive a null Name and should result in a NullPointerException.

cases.expected: findExactMatch(example.com., A) returns RRset containing the ARecord
cases.description: Add a standard A RRset whose name is within the zone origin; the RRset should be stored and retrievable via findExactMatch.

cases.expected: After adding the same RRset twice, findExactMatch(www.example.com., TXT) returns a RRset with a single TXTRecord (no duplicates).
cases.description: Adding an identical RRset a second time should merge records without creating duplicates.
An RRset that contains no records is invalid; the method should reject it with an IllegalArgumentException.
If the RRset's name is not a subdomain of the zone's origin, addRRset should throw an IllegalArgumentException.

cases.expected: findExactMatch(host.example.com., A) returns the A RRset; findExactMatch(host.example.com., AAAA) later returns the AAAA RRset.
cases.description: Adding two RRsets with the same owner name but different types should store both independently.

cases.description: Adding an SOA RRset for the zone origin should set the zone's SOA record, accessible via getSOA().

input.value: RRset{name=example.com., type=NS, records=[NSRecord ns1.example.com. TTL=3600, NSRecord ns2.example.com. TTL=3600] }

cases.expected: getNS() returns the NS RRset containing both NS records

cases.description: The method should handle an RRset containing many records without failure.
The RRset contains a record whose owner name (other.example.com.) does not match the RRset's name (host.example.com.). addRRset should reject this with an IllegalArgumentException.
An RRset that contains a null Record element should cause a NullPointerException when the method attempts to inspect the record.
The RRset type is A but the contained record is an AAAA record. The method should detect the mismatch and throw IllegalArgumentException.

input.value: RRset{name=example.com., type=SOA, records=[SOARecord mname=ns1.example.com. rname=hostmaster.example.com. serial=2023101502 refresh=7200 retry=3600 expire=1209600 minimum=3600 TTL=3600] }

cases.description: A zone may contain only one SOA RRset. Adding a second SOA RRset after the initial one has been added should raise IllegalArgumentException.

input.value: RRset{name=example.com., type=NS, records=[NSRecord ns1.example.com. TTL=3600, NSRecord ns1.example.com. TTL=3600] }

cases.description: Adding an NS RRset that contains duplicate NS records should be rejected with IllegalArgumentException.
The RRset name is not a fully qualified domain name (does not end with a dot). The method should treat this as invalid and throw IllegalArgumentException.
The DNS ANY type is not a concrete RR type for storage. Attempting to add an RRset with type ANY should cause IllegalArgumentException.
